title: New calls and positions: 99 open calls, 95 positions in 17 countries

slides.heading: Asia: 34 open positions
slides.body: PhD, post-doc and faculty roles in Hong Kong, mainland China, the United Arab Emirates, Vietnam, Japan and Taiwan. Asia is now our second region for positions, after Europe.

slides.heading: Asia: new funders on our radar
slides.body: We now read the calls of ICMR and ANRF (India), AMED and JSPS (Japan), NRF and KHIDI (Korea), NSFC (China), NSTC and NHRI (Taiwan) and the e-ASIA programme. The first Asian calls are going through our checks.

slides.heading: Latin America: coming soon
slides.body: Calls and positions from Latin America are coming soon to our page.

slides.heading: New filters by medical area
slides.body: Neurology, physiatry and orthopaedics, ageing and geriatrics, oncology and haematology, clinical genetics and rare diseases: pick your field on the calls page.

slides.heading: Free, and open to everyone
slides.body: Each call shows deadlines and eligibility, with a link to the official text. Add deadlines to your calendar, share any card or follow us via RSS.
slides.highlight: a link to the official text

caption:
New calls and positions on our link in bio: 99 open funding calls and 95 academic positions, every one checked on the official text before it goes online.

By the numbers:
• 99 open calls in clinical research, rehabilitation and clinical engineering
• 42 open internationally
• 95 PhD, post-doc and faculty positions in 17 countries
• 11 methodology carousels you can swipe on the site, no Instagram account needed

Asia is growing fast on our page: 34 open positions in Hong Kong, mainland China, the UAE, Vietnam, Japan and Taiwan, and new funders from India, Japan, Korea, China and Taiwan.

Latin America: coming soon.

New this week: filters for neurology, physiatry and orthopaedics, ageing, oncology and haematology, clinical genetics and rare diseases.

Which country or funder should we add next? Tell us in the comments.

All calls and positions: https://clinical-chaos-dsv.pages.dev

Always check eligibility and deadlines in the official call or advertisement.
